stories.title: Hong Kong invests billions to accelerate innovation of impactful solutions as an AI-powered future comes into focus

en.title: Hong Kong invests billions to accelerate innovation of impactful solutions as an AI-powered future comes into focus
en.summary: Hong Kong is increasing investment to advance artificial intelligence innovation across multiple sectors including industry, public services, research, healthcare and finance, as part of its AI+ initiative and five-year economic development plan.

en.title: (Aichi Nagoya Asian Games) Roundup: China's shooting team finishes with 16 gold medals; China's women's singles tennis secures gold and silver medals in advance
en.summary: China's athletes achieved notable results across multiple sports at the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games on October 1st, including 16 gold medals in shooting and securing top two positions in women's singles tennis.

stories.title: French school protests spread as fires, blockades deepen unrest

en.title: French school protests spread as fires, blockades deepen unrest
en.summary: French secondary school students protested overcrowded classrooms, teacher shortages, and deteriorating facilities on Thursday, with fires set outside schools and blockades in multiple cities. More than 160 schools closed while university students joined demonstrations in Paris and Marseille.

en.title: WTT China Grand Slam First Day: Eight Chinese Players Advance
en.summary: The 2026 World Table Tennis Professional League China Grand Slam tournament began in Beijing on October 1st, with eight Chinese players advancing from the first round of men's and women's singles qualifying matches.

en.title: China Open: Zheng Qinwen, Zhu Lin, Sun Xinran, and Gao Xinyu Advance to Women's Singles Second Round
en.summary: At the 2026 China Open Tennis tournament on October 1st, Chinese players Zheng Qinwen, Zhu Lin, Sun Xinran, and Gao Xinyu all progressed to the second round of women's singles competition.

stories.title: US jobless claims fall to lowest since mid-July

en.title: US jobless claims fall to lowest since mid-July
en.summary: US initial jobless claims declined to 197,000 last week, reaching the lowest level since mid-July, while the four-week average fell to 200,000 as layoffs remain minimal and job security remains strong for most workers.

en.title: Hong Kong National Day Racing Day Draws Large Crowds as Visitors Hope Hong Kong Thrives Like Galloping Horses
en.summary: Hong Kong's Jockey Club held a National Day horse racing event on October 1st at Sha Tin Racecourse to celebrate the 77th anniversary of the People's Republic of China, attracting nearly 30,000 attendees including over 9,300 tourists.

stories.title: EU retools Trump trade war tripwire into China shipments surge alarm

en.title: EU retools Trump trade war tripwire into China shipments surge alarm
en.summary: The EU established a task force in April last year to monitor how US-China trade tensions affected Europe, worried about Chinese goods being redirected to EU markets. The EU is now using this monitoring system as an early warning mechanism amid its own emerging trade dispute with China.

stories.title: Hong Kong needs new funding model to draw investment from global drug makers: AstraZeneca

en.title: Hong Kong needs new funding model to draw investment from global drug makers: AstraZeneca
en.summary: AstraZeneca states that Hong Kong can attract greater biotech investment by establishing a new healthcare financial model. The company has conducted over 60 clinical trials and invested more than HK$200 million in Hong Kong over the past three years despite increased global pharmaceutical investment in mainland China.

stories.title: China extends trade barrier investigations into US practices

en.title: China extends trade barrier investigations into US practices
en.summary: China's Ministry of Commerce has extended two ongoing investigations into US trade barriers and practices, with the new deadline set for December 27, 2026.

stories.title: Hong Kong rises to 14th in Global Innovation Index

en.title: Hong Kong rises to 14th in Global Innovation Index
en.summary: Hong Kong climbed one position to rank 14th among 139 economies in the 2026 Global Innovation Index released by the World Intellectual Property Organization, while maintaining its fifth place position in Asia.

stories.title: China’s carmakers eye record 12 million overseas sales in 2026 as ‘go global’ plan pays off

en.title: China's carmakers eye record 12 million overseas sales in 2026 as 'go global' plan pays off
en.summary: Chinese automakers including BYD and Chery are expanding internationally and expect to achieve record overseas sales of 12 million vehicles in 2026. The companies have become competitive in markets previously dominated by Western manufacturers like Volkswagen, benefiting from geopolitical factors and rising global demand for alternatives.

stories.title: ‘China’s Warren Buffett’ adds Moutai shares for 3rd time as baijiu sector seeks bottom

en.title: 'China's Warren Buffett' adds Moutai shares for 3rd time as baijiu sector seeks bottom
en.summary: Chinese-American billionaire investor Duan Yongping purchased 30,000 additional shares of baijiu maker Kweichou Moutai, marking his third stake increase this year as the sector experiences a downturn. The baijiu industry faces reduced demand due to stricter oversight and anti-corruption measures affecting corporate gifting practices.

stories.title: Hong Kong banks set golden week lures for mainland Chinese visitors despite new levies

en.title: Hong Kong banks set golden week lures for mainland Chinese visitors despite new levies
en.summary: Hong Kong banks are offering incentives to attract mainland Chinese visitors during golden week, including cash bonuses and entertainment experiences, following Beijing's new 20 percent levy on overseas investment and insurance gains.

stories.title: New World Development posts HK$26.8b loss after 11 Skies termination

en.title: New World Development posts HK$26.8b loss after 11 Skies termination
en.summary: New World Development reported a HK$26.8 billion net loss for the year ended June, primarily due to HK$18.3 billion in impairments related to the early termination of its 11 Skies mall project.
